spec.title: Walls: Black stone
spec.metaphor: A compact stepped wall mass built from smooth dressed NEAR-BLACK BASALT RECTANGULAR BLOCKS, five large dark charcoal masonry blocks with crisp horizontal mortar joints and subtle cool-grey edge highlights, with one DARK OXBLOOD RED horizontal stone band across its middle. Solid heavy flat-topped squared masonry silhouette. This is black basalt architecture, absolutely NO crystals, NO purple, NO jagged points, NO glowing mineral shards. Make the black blocks readable against the circular ground with clear pale edge lighting.
spec.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Paint exactly ONE original Turnip Works fantasy tabletop UI pictogram. Specific wall material: A compact stepped wall mass built from smooth dressed NEAR-BLACK BASALT RECTANGULAR BLOCKS, five large dark charcoal masonry blocks with crisp horizontal mortar joints and subtle cool-grey edge highlights, with one DARK OXBLOOD RED horizontal stone band across its middle. Solid heavy flat-topped squared masonry silhouette. This is black basalt architecture, absolutely NO crystals, NO purple, NO jagged points, NO glowing mineral shards. Make the black blocks readable against the circular ground with clear pale edge lighting. Dominant material colours: black and violet. Heroic hand-painted style D: chunky miniature-safe forms, broad soft bevels, matte painted gradients, restrained brushwork. Centered on a dark charcoal circular ground, quiet thin slate rim. Straight-on circular badge, subject fills 80 percent of disc, disc fills 94 percent of square canvas. Upper-left light. Must read at31px: extremely simple silhouette, thick features, generous negative space, no tiny detail. The silhouette and structure must distinguish this choice from its sibling menu choices, not only its colour. Transparent outside circle with native alpha. No text, lettering, numbers, watermark, ornamental border, extra symbols or extra scene. Our own text-only design; no third-party icon references.
